Messages.Author: Jack Crow
Messages.Body:
Can you 'hide' the library cards on a vampire who has been sent back
to the Uncontrolled region?
For example, if it were theoretically possible to make 2 uncontrolled
vampires look the same even tho one had a magnum attached to it when
it was banished, does the player (who has them in their uncontrolled),
have to reveal which one is which?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <3b6f6391....@news.flrtn1.occa.home.com>, Jack Crow
<no...@nowhere.com> writes

>Can you 'hide' the library cards on a vampire who has been sent back
>to the Uncontrolled region?

No. The cards are still there and a matter of public record which any
player can enquire about.

Parallels with Brainwash, which attaches itself to an uncontrolled
vampire.

Correct.

You also cannot "hide" the transfers that have been made to the uncontrolled
vampires (to avoid being hit by Brainwash, for example).
